en.headline: Very hot weather warning reissued as Sunday highs near 33C
en.dek: The Observatory put the warning back in force at 6.45am, forecasting a fine, dry and very hot day with a yellow fire danger warning still in place.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory reissued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 6.45am on Sunday, saying the city would be mainly fine, dry and very hot. Urban temperatures were expected to reach about 33 degrees Celsius, with the New Territories one or two degrees higher, under light to moderate southwesterly winds.

A yellow fire danger warning, first issued at 6am on Friday, remained in force, indicating a high fire risk. At 8am the Observatory recorded 28 degrees and 77 per cent relative humidity. The maximum ultraviolet index was forecast at about 9, in the very high range.

The Department of Health's Centre for Health Protection issued a matching reminder on heat cramps, heat exhaustion and heat stroke. It said infants, older people, pregnant women, people with chronic illness and outdoor workers were most at risk, and advised the public to drink water often, wear light clothing and avoid strenuous activity in the heat.

The Observatory said the next two or three days would stay mainly fine and very hot. Cloud and a few showers are expected around National Day and later in the week as a northeast monsoon gradually affects southern China. Typhoon Surigae was tracking northeast well east of Hong Kong over waters east of the Ryukyu Islands and was not expected to bring a local tropical cyclone signal.

zh.headline: 天文台再發酷熱天氣警告 市區料高見33度
zh.dek: 警告今早6時45分重新生效，預料大致天晴、乾燥及酷熱；黃色火災危險警告仍然生效。
body: 香港天文台今日（27日）早上6時45分再次發出酷熱天氣警告，預料本港大致天晴，日間酷熱及乾燥，市區最高氣溫約33度，新界再高一兩度，吹輕微至和緩西南風。
黃色火災危險警告自周五早上6時發出後仍然生效，火災危險性頗高。早上8時天文台氣溫28度，相對濕77%。預料最高紫外線指數約9，強度屬甚高。
衞生署衞生防護中心同步提醒市民防範熱痙攣、熱衰竭及中暑。署方指嬰兒、長者、孕婦、慢性病患者及戶外工作者較易中暑，應適時補水、穿淺色通爽衣物，並避免在高溫下劇烈活動。
天文台展望未來兩三日大致天晴及酷熱。國慶及本周後期，東北季候風將逐漸影響華南，雲量增多並有幾陣驟雨。麴風舒力基正向東北移動，橫過琉球群島以東海面，遠離香港，預料不會帶來本地熱帶氣旋警告信號。
